catalog.reason: A Catalog page lists what Marfa ships and explains nothing.

catalog/(types)/(system).reason: A type page holds the generated file for its type.

reference/swift-sdk.reason: Lookup page: one part of the Swift SDK's calls and types.

catalog/edges.reason: An edge page holds the generated file for its edge type and one example.

reference/errors.mdx.reason: Lookup page: the one place an error code is explained.

reference/api/index.mdx.reason: Lookup page: the overview of the HTTP API. Operation pages are generated and have no limit here.

(home)/changelog.mdx.reason: An introduction and a component. The releases come from GitHub, not from the page.

reference/cli.mdx.reason: Lookup page: installing the CLI, how it finds a server and credential, its output, and the generated exit codes and global options.

reference/folder-rules.mdx.reason: Lookup page: what a folder does with each kind of file, and the safeguards it holds to.

reference/plugin-format.mdx.reason: Lookup page: a plugin's source folder, the bundle's fields, its connector section and the release index, with the commands that check and build them.

reference/folder-sync-status.mdx.reason: Lookup page: the file the CLI keeps for other programs.

(home)/glossary.mdx.reason: Lookup page: the terms that the docs use, each defined once, plugins, app vendors and plugin connectors included.

reference/marfa-mcp-server.mdx.reason: Lookup page: the endpoints and tools an instance serves over MCP, and the rules a client meets.

reference/mcp-admin-tools.mdx.reason: Lookup page: the tools /mcp/admin serves, the permission each needs and what each previews.

reference/swift-sdk/errors-and-testing.m.reason: Lookup page: errors and testing in the Swift SDK.

reference/swift-sdk/index.mdx.reason: Lookup page: the Swift SDK, its sign-in and server calls.

reference/swift-sdk/items.mdx.reason: Lookup page: items, files and views in the Swift SDK.

reference/swift-sdk/updates.mdx.reason: Lookup page: updates and live queries in the Swift SDK.

reference/swift-sdk/working-copy.mdx.reason: Lookup page: the working copy and its queue in the Swift SDK.

reference/typescript-sdk.mdx.reason: Lookup page: one client's calls and types.

(home)/connect-your-agent.mdx.reason: Takes the steps for six agents, in tabs, and the approval page.

build/access.mdx.reason: Takes in what the owner's browser reaches, and an app's own types, which no grant of all data reaches.

build/change-a-type.mdx.reason: High stakes: renaming or deleting a type moves or removes its items, so the keys, the webhook and app steps, the preview, the move, the end state and the delete stay in one sequence on one page.

build/connect-an-app.mdx.reason: Two flows, the code flow and the device flow, and the web page that takes the first, each with the request it sends and the checks that keep a token chain whole.

build/connectors.mdx.reason: Takes in the items a connector keeps.

build/items-and-types.mdx.reason: Takes in properties, tags and extensions, which are what an item holds.

build/list-filter-search.mdx.reason: Takes in looking up an item by its title, which is one more way to find items.

build/write-safely.mdx.reason: A write can lose another's change or be made twice, so the page gives the version, the conflict, the natural key with its refusals, and the retry key together.

build/files-upload-download.mdx.reason: One file goes through upload, item, download, link and replace, and each step must carry the hash of the reader's own bytes and say what a queued Swift write still lacks.

build/receive-webhooks.mdx.reason: A webhook promises neither order nor once, so the page gives the rule for a copy of the latest state, for a worker that acts on every change, and for a failed delivery.

build/write-in-a-working-copy.mdx.reason: High stakes: a write made offline is sent later and can be refused, so reading and writing in a working copy stay on one page.

catalog/(types)/field-kinds.mdx.reason: Lookup page: the kinds a field takes and the keys each accepts.

catalog/(types)/type-definition.mdx.reason: Lookup page: every key of a type definition and its rule, the namespaces a credential may register under, provenance, display hints and the limits on descriptions and guidance included.

catalog/events.mdx.reason: Lookup page: the generated event types.

catalog/items.mdx.reason: Lookup page: the generated fields every item has.

catalog/permissions.mdx.reason: Lookup page: the generated permissions, the five maps with their CLI flags, and the OAuth scopes.

reference/instance-settings.mdx.reason: Lookup page: the stored and start-only settings, each with its default, and the enforcement levers, which no other page explains.

run/address.mdx.reason: Ways to reach an instance, a public address, and moving the address.

run/back-up-and-restore.mdx.reason: High stakes: a restore that goes wrong loses data, so its steps claim and check the new instance and name what a restore loses.

run/export-and-restore.mdx.reason: Two directions, an archive made and an archive restored, each with its steps, and what a restore brings back of a plugin's connector.

run/run-on-a-server.mdx.reason: Four routes, Railway, a container, Docker from the CLI and a supervisor, each with its own steps.

run/upgrade.mdx.reason: High stakes: it needs the whole-path data-loss check, and going back is its last section.

use/command-line.mdx.reason: Takes in restoring and emptying the bin.

use/limits.mdx.reason: Lookup page: every limit an instance holds to, in one table.

use/google-project.mdx.reason: The steps are in Google's console, which Marfa cannot shorten.
